name: Free Dictionary API
tagline: Free English dictionary API with definitions, phonetics, and word origins.
description: Public Free Dictionary API (dictionaryapi.dev) that returns word definitions, phonetics, part-of-speech entries, meanings, and origin data for English words. No authentication required; simple REST GET endpoints. Commonly used for language tools, learning apps, and NLP demos. Confirm current base URL, rate limits, and response shape from official docs before production use.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public free endpoints; no API key or signup needed for standard dictionary lookups.

use_cases: look up definitions and parts of speech for an English word
fetch phonetic transcription and pronunciation audio URL for a word
get word origin/etymology data when available
build a vocabulary or spelling helper for learning apps
resolve synonyms and related senses from dictionary entries
